source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
	STG.[ACID]
	,STG.[REN_SRL_NUM]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(3,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.DEPOSIT_PERIOD_MTHS,' ',''),''),0)) AS DEPOSIT_PERIOD_MTHS
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(3,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.DEPOSIT_PERIOD_DAYS,' ',''),''),0)) AS DEPOSIT_PERIOD_DAYS
	,CONVERT(DATE,[OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE]) AS OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,[ACCT_OPEN_DATE]) AS ACCT_OPEN_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,[MATURITY_DATE]) AS MATURITY_DATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DEPOSIT_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS DEPOSIT_AMOUNT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([MATURITY_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS MATURITY_AMOUNT
	,STG.[RENEWAL_TYPE]
	,STG.[INT_CR_TBL_CODE]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([OVERDUE_INT_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS OVERDUE_INT_AMT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INTEREST_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS INTEREST_AMOUNT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TDS_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS TDS_AMT
	,STG.[TRAN_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF([TRAN_DATE], 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS TRAN_DATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ADD_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS ADD_AMT
	,STG.[ADD_AMT_CRNCY]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([RENEWAL_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS RENEWAL_AMT
	,STG.[RENEWAL_AMT_CRNCY]
	,STG.[RENEWAL_SCHM_CODE]
	,STG.[RCRE_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,STG.[LCHG_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(3,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.TS_CNT,' ',''),''),0)) AS TS_CNT
	,STG.[SCHM_CODE]
	,STG.[MASTER_B2K_ID]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FIXED_INSTALLMENT_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS FIXED_INSTALLMENT_AMT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(9,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([NRML_INSTALLMENT_PCNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS NRML_INSTALLMENT_PCNT
	,STG.[INSTALLMENT_BASIS]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUMULATIVE_TOP_UP_PAID],' ',''),''),0)) AS CUMULATIVE_TOP_UP_PAID
	,STG.[BANK_ID]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ADD_AMT2],' ',''),''),0)) AS ADD_AMT2
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM d360.STG_DEP_RENEWALHISTTABLE STG
WHERE H = 'D'
